how.title: Three steps to peace of mind
how.subtitle: No paperwork marathons. No crypto wallets. Just your Paytm login.
how.step1Body: We scan a statement, your SMS, or your Paytm activity to find every policy, FD and fund — then flag what's missing a nominee.
how.step2Body: Add nominees and trusted guardians. Everything is encrypted and sealed into your Virasat vault, anchored on Sepolia — no wallet, no gas, no crypto jargon.
how.step3Body: Your everyday Paytm activity is automatic proof of life. If the unthinkable happens, guardians confirm, a challenge window protects against mistakes, and only then is the vault released.

trust.title: Built to be trusted with what matters most
trust.subtitle: This touches grief and money — the two things that deserve the most care.
trust.point1Body: Release rules live on Sepolia. No single person — not even Paytm — can override them.
trust.point2Body: Only cryptographic hashes go on-chain. Your account numbers and documents stay encrypted, always.
trust.point3Body: Every release starts with a challenge window you can cancel. Any activity on your account cancels it automatically.
trust.disclaimer: Virasat is not a will. A nominee may hold assets as a trustee for legal heirs — Virasat helps your family find and claim; succession law still applies.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need a crypto wallet?
faq.a1: No. Virasat creates a secure custodial signer for you behind the scenes. You only ever use your Google login.
faq.a2: Your documents and account details are encrypted (AES-256-GCM) and stored privately. Only tamper-proof hashes are written on-chain — never personal data.
faq.q3: How does Virasat know I'm alive?
faq.a3: Your everyday Paytm activity — logins, payments — automatically resets the vault's inactivity clock. No extra steps.
faq.q4: Can a nominee just take the vault?
faq.a4: No. Release needs sustained inactivity, plus confirmation from a majority of your chosen guardians, plus a challenge window you or any activity can cancel.
